I'm ready to help, but I don't have anything to compare yet — there's no note text, capture, or receipt information in your message. I can't guess which two receipts you mean, and I won't propose or attach any link until you've chosen.

Could you provide:

1. **The note** — its text (as written, including any date/relative wording) or the capture it came from.
2. **The two receipts** — the draft IDs, or enough bank description detail (merchant, amount, date) to identify them in the pending drafts.

Once I have those, I'll lay out each candidate's stored facts next to the note and ask you to pick one before doing anything else.
